contexts.text: In the third state, he speaks piously and devoutly...
With such an appearance of devotion...
However honest, wise, and devout they may have appeared...
They cannot but be devoted to Hell...
The merely natural man (also)... composes his face to devotion...
When the Christian is in devotion...
He then condemns and devotes them to Hell...
When this robber was in such devotion...
In devotion on account of the fear of death...
That those who desire revenge can also pray devoutly.
Thus was I allowed to perceive, with what faith and with what devotion they are and have been in their prayers...
While in such anxiety, confession and devotion is concordant...
Moreover, there is a certain affection of devotion...
She could be in a devout external... and thus excite to what is devout and holy... But it is rare that such are inwardly devout.
Among the Catholics, the worst of all are they who have been devout in the external form...
When musicians... mark out anything devout concerning God... they use the bass.

They were collected who had indeed lived morally, and had frequented places of worship and the Holy Supper, and had then been in devotion, yet cared nothing whatever about the doctrinal things of the Church...
Nor has he any need to appear devout...

They who have believed that salvation consists in prayers and mere devotion... and had also lived well, were collected into one... They said... that they could never find any joy except being in their devotion and prayers; wherefore it was granted them to be among the good in that city... so that they were in their devotion...

He said he had not applied himself to learn the Knowledges of truth and good, but that still he had been in external devotion... He inflowed into the left breast, and I there felt something painful, almost as from those who are in a devout external.
They shaped the countenance and eyes to much devotion... and at last they blew into the affection of devotion and piety of priests.
Sometimes reading books of devotion...
